scope: CUDA nightly only; no weekly or NPU campaign
training_cohort_2: next independent CUDA nightly campaign after duplex fixture fix
native_reference_spread: Per case/dimension: max(existing conservative ceiling, ceil(six-reference range * 1.25 / 0.005) * 0.005)
pixels: All 15 unordered reference-video pairs per case, complete frames/windows and pinned canonical decoder
transient_noise: Maximum two-way reference-cohort excess * 1.25; ceil to 1ms startup-stall / 5ms TTFC

heldout: Freeze before third independent reference cohort and final-source candidates; investigate failure without refitting
